$Comment: What Trim Work pays, split the way the paradigm asks: LEVEL picks the floor, and LUCK decides
how good that floor turns out. This file only ever reads Woodcutting level. It is a ROUTER, not
a payout: every floor's only Grant is a nested Lootable pointing at one of the four
Mmo_Sawmill_Trim_Wage_{Green,Hand,Sawyer,Master} tables, and that nested table is where the
actual XP, essence and offcuts live, scored on Woodcutting luck alone. Retune what a tier is
worth by editing its wage table; retune WHICH tier a level lands on by moving the Min values
ONE ROLL, NO CHANCE. This ladder always fires, so every claim resolves to exactly one of the
four floors below and that floor's nested table always pays something (each wage table's own
zero floor is its safety net). There is nothing to celebrate on the router itself: the floor
reached is silent, and the nested table's own Cue is what fires when the run is genuinely good.
THE ZERO FLOOR IS A SAFETY NET under the level the quest itself asks for. A ladder grants
nothing when every floor sits above the worker's reading, so if a level ever comes in lower than
the quest's own gate implies, a reset, a re-tuned quest, the run still routes to the Green wage
rather than paying nothing at all.
